scheme_name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) for Animal Husbandry, Dairy & Fisheries
source_name: Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying

sections.heading: Scheme Purpose and Working Capital Coverage
sections.content: The Government of India extended the Kisan Credit Card (KCC) facility to Animal Husbandry, Dairy, and Fisheries farmers to meet their short-term working capital requirements. It covers recurring expenses such as animal feed, veterinary medicines, vaccinations, electricity, water charges, breeding, and labor costs for dairy cows, buffaloes, sheep, goats, pigs, and poultry.

sections.heading: Loan Limit and Subsidized Interest Rate
sections.content: Farmers can avail collateral-free short-term working capital loans up to Rs. 2 Lakhs at a base interest rate of 7% per annum. With the Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI) of 3% provided by the Government, the effective interest rate is only 4% per annum for farmers who repay their dues on or before the due date. For farmers holding both crop and animal husbandry KCC, the total collateral-free limit is Rs. 3 Lakhs.

sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria for Dairy and Poultry Farmers
sections.content: Individual farmers, Joint Liability Groups (JLGs), Self Help Groups (SHGs), tenant farmers, and sharecroppers who own, rent, or lease animal sheds and livestock are eligible. Scale of finance is determined locally by the District Level Technical Committee (DLTC) based on unit cost per animal/bird.

sections.heading: Required Documents and Application Process
sections.content: Simplified one-page application form, Aadhaar Card, PAN Card or Form 60, Land records / rental agreement for the shed, bank account details, and animal ownership/health declaration. No processing fee is charged for KCC limits up to Rs. 3 Lakhs.
